title: Background-Oriented Schlieren target
description: Deterministic random-dot target for qualitative visualization of refractive-index gradients in air.

widthPx.title: Target width
widthPx.description: Source raster width. For a screen target, one source pixel per display pixel gives the sharpest pattern.

heightPx.title: Target height
heightPx.description: Source raster height. Width times height is additionally limited by the backend.

intendedDpi.title: Intended print resolution
intendedDpi.description: Physical resolution embedded in the downloaded PNG. Print at 100% scale to preserve this size.

patternSeed.title: Pattern seed
patternSeed.description: Reproduces exactly the same dot positions when every other parameter is unchanged.

dotDiameterPx.title: Dot diameter
dotDiameterPx.description: Diameter of each circular correlation feature in source pixels.

targetFillRatio.title: Requested dot fill
targetFillRatio.description: Approximate foreground area within the active analysis region.

minimumDotSpacingPx.title: Minimum dot spacing
minimumDotSpacingPx.description: Minimum clear edge-to-edge spacing after deterministic jitter.

borderPx.title: Quiet border
borderPx.description: Border excluded from local displacement analysis. Optional orientation markers are placed only here.

fiducialsEnabled.title: Orientation markers
fiducialsEnabled.description: Draw four asymmetric markers outside the active region for later target detection and perspective registration.

invertPattern.title: Invert black and white
invertPattern.description: Use bright dots on a dark background instead of dark dots on a bright background.
